title: Broadband defines 18 human-review rows across six outcomes
summary: Every Broadband contract rehearses accept, reject, clarification, privacy-hold, authority-hold, and period-hold paths without evaluating a candidate record. Denominator: 3 decision tables, 18 rehearsal rows, and zero actual accept decisions.
